title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Program Terms: Enrollment and Business Verification
content:
Every enrollment in Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards starts at ProBuild Member, in status pending verification, and the membership becomes active only once the business is verified.

**1. Starting point.** Every enrollment starts at ProBuild Member in status pending verification. A ProBuild member number is issued at enrollment.

**2. Verification.** The membership becomes active only when the business is verified (business license, EIN or trade license) within the tier's verification period, in days, of the enrollment date; otherwise it is closed.

**3. Enrollment bonus.** On verification, the enrollment bonus points of the starting tier are credited once, as points earned on the enrollment-bonus basis.

**4. Referral bonus.** On that same verification, the referring member, if any, receives the referral bonus points of the referrer's own tier, as points earned on the referral-bonus basis.

**5. Purchases while pending.** Purchases made while the membership is pending verification are credited once it becomes active, when they are within the tier's missed-purchase claim allowance (the number of calendar days after a purchase within which it can be added from the receipt) of the purchase.

## The two outcomes of a pending enrollment

| Business verified within the verification period of the enrollment date | Membership |
|---|---|
| Yes | becomes active, at ProBuild Member; enrollment bonus credited once; referral bonus to the referring member, if any |
| No | closed |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- **Verified, with a referrer.** A business enrolls and, three days after the enrollment date, is verified on its trade license. The membership becomes active at ProBuild Member and the enrollment bonus points of ProBuild Member are credited once. The business had been referred by a member at ProBuild Gold; that member receives the referral bonus points of ProBuild Gold, the referrer's own tier.
- **Not verified.** A business enrolls, and no business license, EIN or trade license verifies it within the verification period. The enrollment is closed; it never becomes active, and no enrollment bonus is credited.
- **A pending-period purchase.** While the membership is pending verification, the business makes a purchase. When the membership becomes active, that purchase is credited if it falls within the missed-purchase claim allowance of the purchase date.
